summary: 겨울철새이지만 가끔 텃새로 머물기도 하며, 남해와 서해의 섬, 철원에서 발견된다. 산림이나 섬, 해안가, 시가지 등의 숲속 나무 위에 나뭇가지로 접시 모양 둥지를 짓고 알 2~3개를 낳는다. 곤충을 비롯한 무척추동물, 죽은 동물, 작은 포유류, 물고기 등을 주로 먹는다. 국외에서는 일본, 중국, 티베트, 히말라야에도 분포한다.

art.subject: Black Kite (Milvus migrans), adult of the eastern form found in Korea, most often seen in winter: overall dark brown with a rufous tinge; head and breast paler buff-brown with dark streaks; a dark brown patch behind the eye on the ear coverts; upperparts dark brown with a paler brown diagonal band across the wing coverts; underparts rufous-brown with pale and dark streaks; underwing dark brown with a large whitish patch at the base of the primaries; tail brown, faintly barred, with a shallow fork. Bill black with a yellow cere; iris dark brown; legs yellow.
art.pose: soaring over the shore, showing the pale underwing patch
art.scene: Korean winter island coast: wooded slopes above a rocky shore; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched: dark rufous-brown plumage with pale brown streaks, paler streaked head with a dark ear patch, yellow cere and legs, long tail with a shallow notch
adult, flight from below: long wings with a large whitish patch at the base of the primaries, dark body, long tail with a shallow fork
adult, flight from below with the tail fanned: tail end looking straight, whitish primary patches, dark body
art.build: Large, long-winged raptor, 58.5–68.5cm, far bigger than a crow, with a small head and short neck. Bill short and hooked, small for the bird. Legs short, yellow. At rest the wingtips reach about the tail tip. Tail long, with a shallow fork that turns square-ended when the tail is fanned; constantly twisted in flight. Soars and glides on long, slightly arched wings, the hand angled back with well-spread fingers.
avoid: Do not paint a deeply forked or rufous-orange tail; that is Red Kite.
Do not give it a short rounded tail like a buzzard or eagle.
Do not paint a white head or a white tail.
Do not omit the whitish primary patches on the underwing.
